notes.title: Items that work
notes.text: Rare Candy, EXP Candy, vitamins, wings, EV-reducing berries, PP Up and PP Max, mints, Ability Capsule and Patch, Bottle Caps, Tera Shards, X items, Dire Hit, Poké Doll, Repel, Escape Rope, Honey, fossils (at a lab or museum), drinks, Sacred Ash and more now have their game effects. Key items, ingredients and collectibles have no battle use; sell them at a shop.

notes.title: Only the Pokémon you send out walk with you
notes.text: Your first partner starts beside you. Other party Pokémon stay in their Poké Balls until you send them out, and the AI is told to keep them unseen and silent.

notes.title: Encounters and the Battle button
notes.text: The battle window opens by itself when an encounter starts from your own message. With Player-chosen encounters on, a Thai name works when the reply shows that Pokémon's header. Wild Pokémon headers in the chat have a Battle button for when the battle did not start.

notes.title: Kinetic only
notes.text: The Original and Aperture themes are removed; saved choices open in Kinetic. Dark mode fixes for the Forms grid and the Field journal.
